comment_content:
I don't know other side of the story of the media company. First of all you
need to assess whether the company is making money or not. If you are sure,
they are profitable or at least have decent traction - then they are stealing
work - don't work. On other hand, if they have closed the venture unable to
run the show, it takes immense guts to fight back and start all over again.
And if they are asking you as a favor to get back into business - you can
negotiate it for 'pay later' or can do little work for free to support the
organization which once paid you well. To conclude, just assess whether they
really cannot pay, whether you have bandwidth for some free work and react
accordingly.
